notes.title: Stickmen Update
notes.content:
We're super excited to announce a [b]massive[/b] new update that introduces a whole new game dynamic that completely changes how you play sand:box... [b]playable characters![/b]

Now you can design levels that you can actually play, allowing you to interact with everything and even play multi-player. We plan to add more objects to use fairly soon, but we rushed this out early so you have something to play for Christmas, enjoy! 
[b]~smellymoo[/b]


[b]Update summary:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]players[/b] - 2 human controllable characters. Should work with controllers or keyboard.
[*] [b]vehicles[/b] - can drive them around, and lean to control your weight distribution.
[*] [b]carry items[/b] - you can drive a motorbike, carry a jetpack and a weapon.
[*] [b]doors[/b] - powered sliding doors that can also be used as elevators.
[*] [b]switches[/b] - players can toggle switches, letting you open doors or control electronics.
[*] [b]climbing[/b] - you can climb edges or up some plants or wires. wood / tin can be used to make ladders.
[*] [b]sound synth[/b] - make retro music for your circuits, great for making retro consoles.
[*] [b]ROM writer[/b] - easy way to change ROMs in game, so you can use them as memory.
[*] [b]data wires[/b] - unlocking incredible computing power, link ROMs together and send everything through logic gates.
[*] [b]mirrors[/b] - redirect laser pulses.
[/list]

notes.title: Circuits & Steamworks Update
notes.content:
We're excited to announce our [b]biggest update[/b] so far, in more than 5 years!

Firstly, [b]Steamworks support[/b], so you can share your designs and gadgets with others.

And we have added [b]30+ new materials[/b] that allow you to make electric circuits. This allows you to make things as complicated as a whole computer processor or 3D printer for example!

[b]New circuit materials:[/b]
[list]
[*] Power supplies - batteries, mains power, steam engine and voltage regulators.
[*] Connections - Wires, bus wires, Junctions and wire links.
[*] Logic gates - Oscillator, OR, AND, NOR, NAND, XOR, NOT, SHIFT registers and D latches.
[*] ROMs - hex editor and addressable ROMs.
[*] peripherals - joypad or keyboard as input.
[*] Devices - Lasers, Tesla coils, Sliding door, Peltier heat pump, Heater wire and conveyor belts.
[*] Displays - LCD and E-ink displays.
[*] LEDs - Red, Green, Blue and 16 color.
[*] Replicator - input a bus, output any material you choose.
[*] Deactivator - disable other Materials.
[*] Switches and Relays.
[/list]

notes.title: Tools & Materials Update
notes.content:
We're happy to announce our first major update.

New Tools:
[list]
[*] Select (Cut, Copy, Paste, Move)
[*] Pick (Pick Materials and View Temperature)
[*] Line (Draw Lines and Snap to Axes (shift))
[/list]
New Materials:
[list]
[*] Improved Nuke (Uranium)
[*] Mimic
[*] Frogspawn
[*] Sunflowers
[*] Bamboo
[*] Magnesium Ribbon
[*] Gallium
[/list]
More coming soon...
